subject: mathematics
content: Let $f$ be a differentiable function on $\mathbf{R}$ such that $f(2)=1, f^{\prime}(2)=4$. Let $\lim \limits_{x \rightarrow 0}(f(2+x))^{3 / x}=\mathrm{e}^\alpha$. Then the number of times the curve $y=4 x^3-4 x^2-4(\alpha-7) x-\alpha$ meets $x$-axis is :
